as_read: Mixed: null on the primary outcome of the largest trial and on blood pressure in a flaxseed oil trial, small pooled lipid and arrhythmia signals, and one positive test among six primary cognitive functions.
stop_list: Eight of ten labels print ALA as the fatty acid fraction beside an oil or omega rows (hemp oil, flaxseed oil, lingonberry seed oil, omega blend); two Brainy Chews print a bare 50 mg row with no oil row. Fields can't separate the fatty acid from its carrier oil.
Label amounts run 50 mg to 2.5 g; trial amounts run 0.97 to 4.7 g, so the 50 mg and 71 mg labels sit far below any trial.
Cognitive-purpose labels print 50 mg against 2.2 g in 36986229.
stored_rating_note: Stored mixed agrees with this read. The stored record has no trial of ALA as an oil supplement; 30392473, 31818531 and 36986229 are flaxseed oil trials. 30392473 and 31818531 appear to report the same 59 participants.
